note: The clause package is the dense timed fixture plus the places, anchors, frames, parameters, constraints, resets, guard and invariant that CL-01 lists; every clause is listed by the root and every reference is joined. The two clock-bearing operations are arm(c: Clock), touch(i: Integer) and size(); a clause refers to an operation by the operation_anchor node of its declaring model with no execution point (FR-342-AC-11).

clock_constraint.bound: a quantity literal of the root's unit node, nonnegative, in lowest terms

clock_reset.value: a quantity literal of the root's unit node, nonnegative, in lowest terms

clock_guard.part: binding predicate, then one reference to a clock_constraint for each constraint of the part, in order; a part names at least one constraint and a guard at least one part

time_invariant.bounds: a nonempty aggregate of references to clock_constraint nodes of kind place whose comparison is lt or le

membership: derived clause-side: a clock_guard, clock_reset, time_invariant or clock_constraint listed by no root aggregate is not a member of the model (a guard that exists is listed, FR-322-AC-243); a clock_constraint is a member through the guard part or invariant that names it, and the root lists every constraint that a part or an invariant names, and no other

quantified_out_of_scope.note: Producer-level cases: they are source text and the refusal a producer gives, not package patches, because no package is emitted for them. The test tc_367_timed_clause_criteria_and_vectors_are_published pins their expected code and cause and that FR-322-AC-263, FR-415-AC-24 and TC-367 CK-37 name them; no reader or producer in this repository executes them (the producer is quire-spec-language, QSL).
